notes: Initial proposed Windows Notepad workflows. Run only in a dedicated disposable pilot sandbox. Each run receives a unique output directory. Expected output text is consumed only by the harness evaluator, not by the executor adapter as metadata.

scenarios.prompt_template:
Using Windows Notepad, create a new plain-text document containing exactly the following three lines, with no extra text:
AVCS CONTROLLED PILOT
Workflow: create-save
Run marker: AVCS-PILOT-ALPHA
Save it as this path: {output_path}
After saving, verify the document is saved. Do not access any other files.
scenarios.expected_text:
AVCS CONTROLLED PILOT
Workflow: create-save
Run marker: AVCS-PILOT-ALPHA

scenarios.fixture_text:
AVCS PILOT FIXTURE
Keep this first line unchanged.
scenarios.expected_text:
AVCS PILOT FIXTURE
Keep this first line unchanged.
APPENDED-BY-AVCS-PILOT

scenarios.prompt_template:
Using Windows Notepad, open this pilot fixture: {fixture_path}
Find the exact token PILOT-OLD-7F31 and replace every occurrence with PILOT-NEW-7F31. Keep all other content unchanged and save the same file. Do not create or modify any other file.
scenarios.fixture_text:
AVCS FIND REPLACE FIXTURE
Token=PILOT-OLD-7F31
Do not change this line.
SecondToken=PILOT-OLD-7F31
scenarios.expected_text:
AVCS FIND REPLACE FIXTURE
Token=PILOT-NEW-7F31
Do not change this line.
SecondToken=PILOT-NEW-7F31
